profiles.description: For thousands of years, China has been on top of the world, until the emergence of the Qing Dynasty, the Manchus ruled the land of China. Because the minority ruled the majority, seclusion and literary inquiry became their means of management. So far, China has experienced hundreds of years of darkness. In modern times, it has become the target of Western Europe, the United States, Japan and other countries. Until his appearance, Mao Zedong, like the sun, sprinkled the truth like light on the land of China, led the people to overthrow the three mountains of imperialism, feudalism, and bureaucracy, and established a new China. On the Korean battlefield, he led the newborn China to fight against seventeen countries with the power of one country. Hit one punch to avoid a hundred punches. Since then, China has once again emerged as a world power. China's current status and achievements are the result of Mao Zedong's leadership. We young people must not give up our original aspirations, we must carry on the past and forge ahead, and China will definitely become stronger in our hands.
